messages:
nina_sales: Hi all — Taylor from Orbit asked for a hosted API key to run a 10-day POC. They want easy rotation and ability to immediately revoke if they hand it back early. No IP allowlist on their side. tagging @carlos_se and @anya_security for risk/flow.

carlos_se: We generally issue short-lived keys. Proposal: 10d TTL but create as 3d rolling (create new at day 3 and day 6) so they never have >3d valid key. Enforce per-key token cap (50k) and model routing to `small-gen` family.

taylor_customer: 50k tokens should be fine. Prefer emailed signed link to retrieve key (not plaintext key in email). Also want an auto-revoke endpoint for our security team to call if needed.

anya_security: Ok. Conditions: TTL <= 14d, audit logging on, tags include poc=orbit and requested_by=taylor. We can expose an internal revocation webhook for emergencies (authz via a short-lived HMAC token). Formal sign-off once SE documents the flow.

carlos_se: Steps for SE to create key via REST: 
```
POST /v1/keys
{ "name": "orbit-poc-1", "ttl": "10d", "tags": ["poc:orbit","owner:nina_sales"], "quota_tokens": 50000, "routing_policy": "small-gen-only" }
```
Revoke: POST /v1/keys/<id>/revoke  (returns 200 when revoked).
```
# sample revoke call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/key_orbit_9abc/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW_TOKEN"
```
Also support Console flow: Console -> API Keys -> New -> set TTL/quota/tags -> Create signed retrieval link.

ops_bot: Key created: id=key_orbit_9abc, created_by=nina_sales, expires_in=10d, quota=50000 tokens, routing=small-gen-only. Signed retrieval link generated, expires in 12h.

taylor_customer: Got the link and did a generate+embed smoke test. Embedding call works. Metrics visible in Console. Thanks. Latency ~200ms.

anya_security: Rotation playbook (short):
- Create key A (day0).
- Day3 create key B, provide signed link, ask client to switch within maintenance window. Monitor 15m then revoke A.
- Day6 create key C, repeat.
- Final day: revoke last key and provide audit slice.
Notes: keep rotation ticket in CRM and add key IDs + audit export.

carlos_se: I made a small script to automate swap+revoke. I'll attach to the SE workspace. Reminder to customer: store key in secret manager, do not check into repo.

nina_sales: I'll send the rotation schedule to Orbit and create a CRM task to follow up on final revocation + audit handover. If they want a one-click emergency revoke endpoint, @anya_security we need to coordinate auth for their ops team.

taylor_customer: We'll take the HMAC webhook if available. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

anya_security: We'll provision a one-time HMAC token for their security contact after MSA is signed. Until then we require revocation via support ticket or SE action.

nina_sales: Cool — closing loop once final revoke + audit slice delivered. :white_check_mark:
